body:
Founder real-time: 'the alpine pi installable parena powered emily os.' New step 3b in build-pi-image-rootless.sh cross-compiles parenabusybox and parenash for aarch64, reusing the root-less Debian cross-toolchain step 3 already bootstraps -- PARENA's compiler runs natively to emit portable C, only the final compile needs the cross-compiler. Staged available-not-default (turbogrep/turbosed precedent): parenabusybox's applets live in /usr/local/parena-coreutils/, off default PATH; parenash goes directly in /usr/local/bin/. Real, previously-undiscovered gap found and fixed along the way, affecting the pre-existing emilyos binary too: the cross-toolchain targets glibc but Alpine ships musl, an incompatible dynamic-linker ABI -- found by actually executing cross-compiled binaries under root-lessly-bootstrapped qemu-user-static (not just checking file(1) architecture), meaning every prior build shipped a binary that could never start. Fixed via static linking for both; live-verified emilyos --help, all 4 parenabusybox applets, and a real parenash script all execute correctly against the real rootfs. Commit 5582db9.

⚓ ☃
title: Pi image: PARENA-powered coreutils/shell staged for aarch64 + musl/glibc ABI fix
